wireframes.primaryQuestion: What can I safely try first?
wireframes.nextAction: Open the fixture-backed quickstart and preview a simulated plan.
accessibilityNotes: Keyboard order follows rail stage order.
State labels are text, not color-only.

wireframes.primaryQuestion: What must be ready before inviting the team?
wireframes.nextAction: Confirm workspace, project, and ownership prerequisites before invite expansion.
accessibilityNotes: Owner and blocker labels are exposed as headings.

wireframes.primaryQuestion: Which provider and policy prerequisites block the first plan?
wireframes.nextAction: Inspect the Gatekeeper and provider-readiness evidence before launch simulation.
accessibilityNotes: Reduced-motion mode keeps the same state order.

wireframes.primaryQuestion: Where is the user stuck and who owns the next unblock?
wireframes.nextAction: Open the redacted support handoff with evidence id, owner, and safe wording.
accessibilityNotes: Support route is reachable without hover.
Unknown evidence is announced as blocked, not success.

stateModel.entryCondition: User has an invite link or anonymous try-it path.
stateModel.exitCondition: Persona and desired outcome are captured.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Show access requirement and preserve anonymous fixture path.

stateModel.entryCondition: Outcome is captured and workspace context is available.
stateModel.exitCondition: Workspace profile, tenant boundary, and admin owner are known.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Keep rail blocked with owner route instead of implying workspace readiness.

stateModel.entryCondition: Workspace is selected with permission to create or choose a project.
stateModel.exitCondition: Project, environment, and safe-test fixture are selected.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Route to project setup and keep deploy actions disabled.

stateModel.entryCondition: A collected manifest or accepted quickstart fixture exists.
stateModel.exitCondition: Plan, risk, policy disposition, and approval needs are visible.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Show missing manifest or unknown evidence as a blocked preview.

stateModel.entryCondition: Plan preview has no unresolved blockers or unsupported live claims.
stateModel.exitCondition: Simulated launch status, rollback path, and guardrail outcomes are recorded.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Disable live launch and show simulated-only proof mode.

stateModel.entryCondition: Plan, launch, or evidence state is blocked, stale, unknown, or failed.
stateModel.exitCondition: Safe next action, owning team, and support route are identified.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Create a support-safe handoff without exposing customer data.

stateModel.entryCondition: Simulated or fixture-backed outcome has inspectable evidence.
stateModel.exitCondition: User-facing proof, docs link, and follow-up owner are recorded.
stateModel.missingPrerequisiteBehavior: Show evidence unavailable rather than a green success state.

outcomes.title: Fixture plan reaches value proof
outcomes.userMessage: Your first proof is simulated and inspectable from the quickstart fixtures.

outcomes.title: Prerequisite blocks launch
outcomes.userMessage: Launch is blocked until the named owner resolves the prerequisite.

outcomes.title: Evidence is stale or unknown
outcomes.userMessage: The rail cannot mark success until fresh replay-derived evidence exists.

outcomes.title: Support-safe handoff
outcomes.userMessage: Support gets owner, evidence id, next action, and redaction state.

proofModeLegend.label: Live-gated
proofModeLegend.meaning: Names a future live handoff that remains gated by release, policy, and credential controls.

proofModeLegend.label: Simulated
proofModeLegend.meaning: Runs against mocked service boundaries and deterministic quickstart fixtures.

proofModeLegend.label: Reference fixture
proofModeLegend.meaning: Reads checked-in fixture or transcript-equivalent evidence.

proofModeLegend.label: Scope-out
proofModeLegend.meaning: Explicitly prevents downstream artifacts from making unsupported launch claims.
